title: No-code personal agents, powered by GPT-4.1 and Realtime API
summary: Learn how Genspark built a $36M ARR AI product in 45 days—with no-code agents powered by GPT-4.1 and OpenAI Realtime API.
body: Learn how Genspark built a $36M ARR AI product in 45 days—with no-code agents powered by GPT-4.1 and OpenAI Realtime API.
summaryZh: 文章介绍了Genspark利用GPT-4.1和OpenAI Realtime API在45天内构建无代码个人Agent产品并实现3600万美元ARR的案例。该案例展示了当前Agent技术在快速产品化和商业变现方面的潜力，特别是通过实时API提升交互体验的路径。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了基于最新API构建AI产品的商业案例，体现了Agent技术的落地能力。
